summary: Kentucky First Federal Bancorp filed an 8-K on July 28, 2026, announcing a $0.05 per share quarterly dividend, payable September 21, 2026, to shareholders of record August 31, 2026. The board also disclosed that members of First Federal MHC, which holds 58.5% of outstanding shares, voted to waive its right to receive dividends aggregating up to $0.40 per share over the next 12 months, extending a prior waiver pattern from 2012–2023. This waiver benefits minority shareholders by increasing their proportionate dividend flow. The event is a routine capital return with ongoing MHC dividend waivers; watch for future waiver renewals and dividend sustainability.
